Travel|Beginner.example: J'ai réservé une chambre avec vue sur la mer.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a room with a bed where you sleep
Travel|Beginner.translation: I booked a room with a sea view.

Travel|Beginner.example: Ma valise est trop lourde pour ce vol.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a case for carrying clothes on a journey
Travel|Beginner.translation: My suitcase is too heavy for this flight.

Travel|Beginner.example: J'ai acheté mon billet de train sur Internet.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a printed card that lets you travel
Travel|Beginner.translation: I bought my train ticket online.

Travel|Beginner.example: Montrez votre passeport au contrôle, s'il vous plaît.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: an official booklet you need to travel abroad
Travel|Beginner.translation: Please show your passport at the checkpoint.

Travel|Beginner.example: Le bus numéro douze passe toutes les dix minutes.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a large road vehicle carrying many passengers
Travel|Beginner.translation: The number twelve bus comes every ten minutes.

Travel|Beginner.example: On a pris un taxi jusqu'au centre-ville.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a car you pay to drive you somewhere
Travel|Beginner.translation: We took a taxi to the city centre.

Travel|Beginner.example: Le métro est le moyen le plus rapide pour traverser la ville.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: an underground train system in a city
Travel|Beginner.translation: The metro is the quickest way to cross the city.

Travel|Beginner.example: Nous avons loué une voiture pour visiter la région.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a small vehicle you drive on the road
Travel|Beginner.translation: We rented a car to explore the region.

Travel|Beginner.example: La plage est à dix minutes à pied de l'appartement.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a stretch of sand beside the sea
Travel|Beginner.translation: The beach is a ten-minute walk from the flat.

Travel|Beginner.example: Nous partons en vacances la semaine prochaine.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: free days away from work or school
Travel|Beginner.translation: We are going on holiday next week.

Travel|Beginner.example: Regarde la carte, je crois qu'on s'est trompés de rue.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a drawing that shows roads and places
Travel|Beginner.translation: Look at the map, I think we took the wrong street.

Travel|Beginner.example: Il faut partir tôt demain matin pour éviter les bouchons.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: to leave a place
Travel|Beginner.translation: We have to leave early tomorrow morning to avoid the traffic.

Travel|Beginner.example: Nous devrions arriver à Marseille vers dix-huit heures.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: to reach the place you were heading for
Travel|Beginner.translation: We should get to Marseille around six in the evening.

Travel|Beginner.example: Continuez tout droit jusqu'au grand carrefour.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: straight ahead, without turning
Travel|Beginner.translation: Keep going straight ahead until the big crossroads.

Travel|Intermediate.example: J'ai confirmé ma réservation par courriel hier soir.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a place or seat booked in advance
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I confirmed my booking by email last night.

Travel|Intermediate.example: L'embarquement se fera porte trente-deux.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: getting on board a plane, train or boat
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Boarding will take place at gate thirty-two.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Notre vol fait une escale de deux heures à Amsterdam.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a short stop in the middle of a journey
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Our flight has a two-hour stopover in Amsterdam.

Travel|Intermediate.example: J'ai raté ma correspondance parce que le premier train est arrivé trop tard.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the next service you change onto
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I missed my connection because the first train arrived too late.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Le décollage a été repoussé à cause du mauvais temps.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the moment a plane leaves the ground
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Take-off was put back because of the bad weather.

Travel|Intermediate.example: L'atterrissage s'est fait en douceur malgré le vent.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the moment a plane touches the ground
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The landing was smooth despite the wind.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Nous sommes passés à la douane sans aucun problème.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the border service that checks what you carry
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We went through customs without any trouble.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Nous cherchons un hébergement pas trop cher près du centre.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a place to stay while you are away
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We are looking for reasonably priced accommodation near the centre.

Travel|Intermediate.example: On a dormi dans une auberge de jeunesse pour économiser.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a cheap hostel mainly for young travellers
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We slept in a youth hostel to save money.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Je vais devoir annuler mon vol de lundi.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: to call off something you had arranged
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I'm going to have to cancel my Monday flight.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Le train a une heure de retard à cause d'un incident technique.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the time by which something is late
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The train is an hour late because of a technical problem.

Travel|Intermediate.example: J'ai préparé un itinéraire détaillé pour nos cinq jours à Rome.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the planned route of a journey
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I have put together a detailed itinerary for our five days in Rome.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Nous avons passé un séjour formidable en Corse.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a period of time spent in one place
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We had a wonderful stay in Corsica.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Le train part du quai numéro sept dans cinq minutes.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the platform where you board a train
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The train leaves from platform seven in five minutes.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Vous pouvez acheter vos billets au guichet, à côté de l'entrée.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a small counter where tickets are sold
Travel|Intermediate.translation: You can buy your tickets at the ticket desk, next to the entrance.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Il faut payer un supplément pour la deuxième valise.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: an extra amount you have to pay
Travel|Intermediate.translation: You have to pay an extra charge for the second suitcase.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Nous sommes restés bloqués une heure dans un embouteillage.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a long queue of cars that barely moves
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Arrête-toi au péage, j'ai la carte bancaire.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a point where you pay to use a road
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Pull up at the toll booth, I've got the bank card.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Il faut un visa pour entrer dans ce pays.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: official permission to enter a country
Travel|Intermediate.translation: You need a visa to enter this country.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Passe à l'office de tourisme, ils donnent des plans gratuits.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: an office giving visitors local information
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Drop by the tourist office, they hand out free maps.
